en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate multi‑span bridge crossing a river. On the right stands a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped dome. Along the riverbank are multi‑storey buildings with shops; one large wall advertisement reads "QUAKER OATS". In the background, on a wooded hill, stands a fortress complex. Printed at the top is the title "Gruss aus Graz mit Erzherz. Franz Carl-Brücke." Handwritten notes and a date appear faintly above the image.
